title: COMMAND YOUR MORNING WITH FIRE!!
text: Glory to God. Before we go into this powerful time of prayer and ministration, I want you to do something for me. Share this prayer with somebody. Don't keep it to yourself. There is a principle in the kingdom empire. When you distribute light, you multiply light. When you share spiritual content, you are not just blessing someone else. You are activating a law of reciprocity in the spirit realm. The Bible says in Luke chapter 6 verse 38, "Give, and it shall be given unto you. Good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over shall men give into your bosom." When you share this with five people, 10 people, 20 people, you are [music] sowing a seed in the lives of others, and that seed will speak for you in the realm of the spirit. So, right now, as an act of obedience and as an act of faith, share this ministration. Send it to your family members. Send it to your friends. Post it on your platforms, because somebody needs to hear what the spirit of God is about to release. Somebody is under siege. Somebody's morning has been hijacked by the enemy, >> [music] >> and this word will be their deliverance. So, do it now. Share it. Distribute it, and watch how God will reward your obedience. Now, I want us to go into a realm of prayer that will transform your experience every single day. The title of our ministration is Command Your Morning with Fire. And I need you to understand something that is fundamentally critical. The morning time is not just another time of the day. In the realm of the spirit, the morning carries a unique anointing, a unique grace, a unique jurisdiction, that if you understand it and you learn how to appropriate it, your life will never be the same again. The Bible is replete with examples of men and women who understood the power of the morning hour. In the book of Mark chapter 1 verse 35, the Bible says, "And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, he went out and departed into a solitary place, and there prayed." Jesus Christ, the son of the living God, understood that there is something about the morning that gives you an advantage in the realm of the spirit. When you wake up in the morning, you are waking up into a new day, a new season, new opportunities, but you're also waking up into a battlefield. The enemy knows that if he can sabotage your morning, he can sabotage your [music] entire day. If he can inject fear into your morning, you will walk in fear all day. If he can inject discouragement into your morning, you will be discouraged throughout that day. But if you can take charge of your morning, if you can command your morning, if you can set the spiritual tone and temperature of your morning, you will dictate how that day goes. This is why the psalmist said in Psalm chapter 5 verse 3, "My voice shall thou hear in the morning, O Lord. In the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up." The word direct there is a military term. It means to set in array, to arrange in battle formation. So, when you pray in the morning, you are not just saying prayers. You are arranging your day. You are setting things in order. You are taking your position as a king and a priest, and you are declaring the will of God over your life. I want you to understand that you have been given authority. The Bible says in Luke chapter 10 verse 19, "Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy, and nothing shall by any means hurt you." That word power in the Greek is exousia. It means authority, jurisdiction, delegated influence. You have been given the legal right to command things in the realm of the spirit. [music] You are not begging. You are not wishing. You are not hoping. You are commanding. But many believers wake up every morning as victims. They wake up and they say, "I wonder what today will bring. I hope things will be okay." No, you don't hope. You decree. You don't wonder. You declare. You don't wish. You command. Because you carry the authority of the kingdom of God. Now, I want to take you into a dimension of prayer where you will learn to command your morning with fire. And when I say fire, I'm not talking about physical fire. I'm talking about the fire of the Holy Ghost. I'm talking about the consuming fire of God's presence. The Bible says in Hebrews chapter 12 verse 29, "For our God is a consuming [music] fire." Fire in the Bible represents several things. It represents the presence of God. It represents purification. It represents judgment against the enemy. It represents empowerment. [music] It represents illumination. When you command your morning with fire, you are inviting the manifest presence of God into your day. You are purging every contamination from your atmosphere. You are releasing judgment against every demonic agenda. You are empowering yourself for exploits. You are bringing light into every dark area of your life. Let me show you something from the book of Job. In Job chapter 1, the Bible describes how Satan came to present himself before God, and God asked him, "Where are you coming from?" And Satan said, "From going to and fro in the earth, and from walking up and down in it." This tells you that the devil is actively moving, actively monitoring, actively seeking whom he may devour. He's studying your patterns, studying your weaknesses, studying your vulnerabilities. And one of the times he strikes the most is in the morning, because if he can establish a beachhead in your morning, he can control your day. But when you command your morning, you are shutting the door against his access. You are setting up a boundary. You are establishing a hedge of protection that he cannot penetrate. The book of Isaiah chapter 60 verse 1 says, "Arise, shine, for thy light is come, and the glory of the Lord is risen upon thee." Every morning when you wake up, light is coming. Glory is rising, but you must arise to receive it. You must position yourself to appropriate [music] it. Many people sleep through their morning, and they wonder why their day is dark. You cannot be passive about your morning and expect to have an extraordinary day. You must be intentional. You must be aggressive. You must be violent in the spirit. The Bible says in Matthew chapter 11 verse 12, "And from the days of John the Baptist until now, the kingdom of heaven suffereth violence, and the violent take it by force." You must take your day by force. You must command your morning by force. Now, there are certain things that happen when you command your morning. Number one, you set the spiritual atmosphere of your day. The atmosphere determines what can fly and what cannot fly in your life. When the atmosphere is right, blessings can fly. When the atmosphere is wrong, curses can operate. So, when you wake up in the morning and you begin to pray, you begin to worship, you begin to decree the word of God, you are changing the atmosphere. You are saturating your environment with the presence of God. And when the presence of God is thick in your atmosphere, demons cannot operate. Sickness cannot thrive. Failure cannot establish itself. Poverty cannot build a stronghold, because light has come, and darkness must flee. Number two, when you command your morning, you receive fresh instructions for that day. Every day comes with its own assignment, its own opportunities, its own challenges. And God wants to give you wisdom and strategy for that specific day. But if you rush into your day without seeking his face, you will miss the instructions. You will miss the warnings. You will miss the open doors. The Bible says in Isaiah chapter 50 verse 4, "He wakeneth morning by morning. He wakeneth mine ear to hear as the learned." God wants to speak to you every morning. He wants to download wisdom into your spirit. He wants to show you what to do and what to avoid. But you must create the space. You must create the time. You must position yourself in his presence. Number three, when you command your morning, you release angelic assistance over your life. The Bible says in Psalm 91 verse 11, "For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways." Angels are ministering spirits, sent forth to minister for those who are heirs of salvation. But angels respond to the word of God. The Bible says in Psalm 103 verse 20, "Bless the Lord, ye his angels, that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word." When you speak the word of God in the morning, when you declare scriptures, when you make prophetic decrees, you are activating angels. You are giving them assignments. You are sending them ahead of you to prepare the way, to open doors, to fight battles, to protect you from traps and snares. Number four, when you command your morning, you frustrate the plans of the enemy. The devil is a strategist. He plans. He plots. He schemes. But the Bible says in Isaiah chapter 8 verse 10, "Take counsel together, and it shall come to naught. Speak the word, and it shall not stand, for God is with us." When you pray in the morning, you are frustrating the counsel of the enemy. You are scattering his plans. [music] You are dismantling his agenda. You are overturning his verdicts. You are nullifying his decrees. And by the time he tries to execute his plans against you, he will discover that the ground has shifted, the atmosphere has changed, and his weapons cannot prosper. Now, let me take you into the realm of practical application. How do you command your morning? What do you do? What do you say? Let me give you a framework, a template, a pattern that you can follow. First, you begin with thanksgiving. The Bible says in Psalm 100 verse 4, "Enter into his gates with thanksgiving and into his courts with praise. Be thankful unto him and bless his name." Thanksgiving opens the gates. It gives you access. It positions you for encounter. So, when you wake up, before you start making requests, before you start declaring things, say thank you. Thank God for the gift of life. Thank him for protection through the night. Thank him for his mercy. Thank him for his faithfulness. [music] Thank him for the breath in your lungs. Thank him for the blood of Jesus. Thank him for salvation. Thank him for destiny. Thanksgiving is a weapon. It silences the voice of the enemy. It shifts your focus from what is wrong to what is right. It lifts your spirit and prepares you for the next level. After thanksgiving, you move into worship. Worship is different from thanksgiving. Thanksgiving is about what God has done. Worship is about who God is. So, you begin to magnify his name. You begin to exalt him. You say, "Lord, you are Elohim, the creator of heaven and earth. You are El Shaddai, the almighty God. You are Jehovah Jireh, my provider. You are Jehovah Rapha, my healer. You are Jehovah Nissi, my banner. You are Jehovah Shalom, my peace. You are the alpha and the omega, the beginning and the end, [music] the first and the last. You are the lily of the valley, the bright and morning star. You are the rose of Sharon, the altogether lovely one. When you worship, you are ascending into the realm of his presence. You are touching the throne. You are connecting with the source. And from that place of connection, everything else begins to flow. After worship, you move into the word. You speak the word of God over your life. You decree scriptures. You declare promises. Find scriptures that speak to your current situation, your current need, your current season, and declare them with authority. If you need provision, declare Philippians 4 verse 19. "My God shall supply all my need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus." If you need protection, declare Psalm 91. "He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most high shall abide under the shadow of the almighty. I will say of the Lord, he is my refuge and my fortress, my God. In him will I trust." If you need wisdom, declare James 1 verse 5. "If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God [music] that giveth to all men liberally and upbraideth not, and it shall be given him." The word of God is living and powerful. It is sharper than any two-edged sword. When you speak it, you are releasing creative power. You are releasing transforming power. You are releasing delivering power. After the word, you move into prophetic declarations. This is where you begin to command your morning. You say things like, "This morning, I decree that every satanic agenda against my life is frustrated in the name of Jesus. Every evil counsel against my destiny is scattered. Every trap set for me is exposed and dismantled. Every arrow fired at me returns to the sender sevenfold. I decree that no weapon formed against me shall prosper, and every tongue that rises against me in judgment, I condemn. I decree that this [music] day is blessed. This day is ordained for my advancement. This day carries divine opportunities. This day carries supernatural breakthroughs. I decree that favor surrounds me like a shield. Divine connections locate me. Strategic relationships are established. Financial miracles manifest in my life. I decree that sickness has no [music] place in my body. Disease has no authority over me. By the stripes of Jesus, I am healed. By the blood of Jesus, I am whole. I decree that my mind is sharp, my spirit is alert, my body is strong. [music] I walk in supernatural health. I walk in divine strength. I walk in overflowing vitality." You continue. "I decree that confusion has no place in my decisions. The spirit of God leads me. The wisdom of God guides me. I make accurate decisions. I take right steps. I avoid every trap. I sidestep every snare. I decree that my business prospers. My career advances. My ministry expands. My relationships flourish. My family is blessed. My children walk in covenant. My spouse walks in purpose. My home is a habitation of glory. I decree that the anointing of God [music] rests upon me. The fire of God burns in me. The power of God flows through me. Signs and wonders follow me. Miracles and breakthroughs accompany me. I am a carrier of God's presence. I am a vessel of his glory. I am an instrument of his power. Everywhere I go, darkness flees. Everywhere I step, captives are set free. I decree that today, I will not be a victim, but a victor. I will not be defeated, but triumphant. I will not be depressed, but joyful. I will not be anxious, but peaceful. I will not be confused, but clear. I will not be weak, but strong. I am more than a conqueror through him that loved me. After prophetic declarations, you move into spiritual warfare. This is where you engage the enemy directly. You pull down strongholds. You bind demonic forces. You loose angelic reinforcements. You say, "In the name of Jesus, I come against every spirit of delay. You will not hinder my progress. You will not stagnate my advancement. I command you to release what belongs to me. In the name of Jesus, I come against [music] every spirit of poverty. You will not impoverish my life. You will not drain my resources. I break your hold. I destroy your grip. I command financial restoration. I command supernatural provision. In the name of Jesus, I come against every spirit of infirmity. You will not afflict my body. You will not weaken my health. I command you to leave. I command sickness to depart. I release healing virtue into every cell of my body. In the name of Jesus, I come against every spirit of confusion. You will not cloud my judgment. You will not distort my perception. I command clarity. I command understanding. I command wisdom. In the name of Jesus, I pull down every [music] stronghold of fear. Every imagination of failure, every thought of defeat, I cast them down. I bring them into captivity to the obedience of Christ. In the name of Jesus, I bind every territorial spirit assigned against my city, my nation, my generation. Your authority is revoked. Your assignment [music] is canceled. I loose the spirit of revival. I loose the spirit of awakening. I loose the spirit of transformation. In the name of Jesus, I take authority over the day. I decree that every evil power that wakes up before me [music] to plan evil against me, you are arrested. Every satanic programmer that sits in the second heaven to code my day with failure, your program is deleted. Every witchcraft coven that holds meetings in the night to curse my morning, your curses are reversed. They return to you sevenfold. Every ancestral spirit that has been assigned to monitor my family line, your assignment ends today. Every generational curse that has followed my lineage, you are broken. Every evil covenant that was established by my forefathers, you are nullified by the blood of Jesus. After spiritual warfare, you move into intercession. You pray for others. You pray for your family. You pray for your church. You pray for your nation. You pray for the advancement of God's kingdom. The Bible says in 1 Timothy chapter 2 verse 1, "I exhort therefore, that first of all, supplications, prayers, intercessions, and giving of thanks be made for all men." When you intercede, you are standing in the gap. You are becoming a bridge between heaven and earth. You are releasing the purposes of God into the lives of others. And there is a blessing that comes upon [music] intercessors. There is a protection that covers those who pray for others. There is a favor that surrounds those who carry the burden of intercession. Now, I want to pray with you right now. I want you to engage with me in the spirit. I want you to open your mouth and begin to pray. Don't just read these words. Speak them out loud. Release them with authority. Decree them with faith. Let's go. Father, I thank you for the gift of this new day. I thank you for the breath of life. I thank you for your mercy that is new every morning. I thank you for your faithfulness that never fails. I thank you for the blood of Jesus that speaks better things. I thank you for the finished work of Calvary. I thank you for salvation, for deliverance, for healing, for provision. I magnify your name, oh Lord. You are worthy to be praised. You are glorious in holiness, fearful in praises, doing wonders. There is none like you among the gods. Your throne is established from of old. You are from everlasting. I exalt you. I lift you up. I crown you as the king of my life, the lord of my day, the master of my destiny. Father, I decree by the authority vested in me by the word of God that this morning is blessed. This day is sanctified. This season is ordained for my advancement. I decree that every evil agenda fashioned against me in the dark places is exposed and destroyed. Every counsel of the wicked is brought to nothing. Every plan of the enemy is frustrated. Every trap set for my feet is exposed [music] and dismantled. I command every arrow of darkness fired at me to return to the sender. I command every word spoken against me in the covens and the secret places to fall to the ground and die. I decree that no weapon formed against me shall prosper. Every tongue that rises against me in judgment, I condemn. This is my heritage as a servant of the Lord and my righteousness is of you, oh Lord. I decree that this day carries divine opportunities. Doors are opening that no man can shut. Connections are being made that will advance my purpose. Relationships are being established that will accelerate my destiny. I decree that favor surrounds me like a shield. I have favor with God and with men. Kings and queens of the earth are being positioned to bless me. Influential people are being ordained to help me. Strategic alliances have been formed. I am walking into a season of uncommon favor, unusual breakthroughs, unprecedented blessings. I decree over my finances, poverty is not my portion, lack is not my heritage, insufficiency is not my identity. I am blessed. I am prosperous. I am abundant. Money locates me. Wealth flows to me. Resources come to me from expected and unexpected places. My hands are blessed. My business is blessed. My career is blessed. My investments are blessed. Everything I touch prospers. Everything I do succeeds. I am the head and not the tail. I am above and not beneath. I am a lender and not a borrower. The Lord has opened his good treasure, the heaven, to give the rain onto my land in its season and to bless all the work of my hand. I decree over my health, I am healed. I am whole. I am strong. By the stripes of Jesus I was healed. That healing is manifesting now in my body. Every sickness is leaving. Every disease is departing. Every infirmity is being uprooted. I speak to my immune system, be strong. I speak to every organ, every tissue, every cell, function according to divine design. I speak to my blood, be purified. I speak to my bones, be strengthened. I speak to my mind, be renewed. I am healthy. I am vibrant. I am full of life. No plague shall come near my dwelling. No evil shall befall me. I walk in divine health. I walk in supernatural strength. I decree over my family, my household is blessed. My spouse is blessed. My children are blessed. My parents are blessed. My siblings are blessed. We are a covenant family. We are a blessed generation. No one in my family will die prematurely. No one in my family will walk in darkness. No one in my family will be a victim of the enemy. We are all covered by the blood of Jesus. We are all surrounded by the fire of God. We are all walking in purpose. We are all fulfilling destiny. My children are taught of the Lord and great is their peace. They walk in wisdom. They excel in their generation. They are leaders and not followers. They are influencers and not influenced. They carry the glory of God. They manifest the excellence of God. I decree over my mind, confusion is not my portion. Anxiety is not my heritage. Depression is not my identity. I have the mind of Christ. My thoughts are ordered by the word of God. My emotions are controlled by the spirit of God. Peace rules in my heart. Joy fills my soul. Hope >> [music] >> anchors my spirit. I am stable. I am sound. I am strong. I cast down imaginations and every high thing that exalts itself against the knowledge of God and I bring into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ. Now, I engage the enemy. In the name of Jesus, I bind every spirit of delay assigned against my life. You will not hold back my breakthroughs. You will not postpone my miracles. You will not stagnate my progress. I command you to release what belongs to me. Release my blessings. Release my opportunities. Release my connections. Release my resources. In the name of Jesus, I bind every spirit of poverty that has been trailing my family line. Your assignment ends today. I break your hold. I destroy your grip. I command you to leave my life. Leave my family. Leave my lineage. In the name of Jesus, I bind every spirit of sickness that has been afflicting my body. You have no authority. You have no permission. You have no legal right. I command you to leave. I release healing virtue. I release divine health. I release supernatural strength. In the name of Jesus, I come against every witchcraft operation targeting my morning. Every satanic altar where my name is being mentioned, I command fire from heaven to consume those altars. Every evil priest ministering at those altars, I command confusion into your camp. Every sacrifice offered against me, I command it to backfire. Every incantation [music] chanted against me, I command it to return to the sender. Every evil image or representation of me being used for manipulation, I command it to burn to ashes. Every evil covenant or agreement made concerning me by my ancestors, I renounce it. I break it. I nullify it by the blood of Jesus. In the name of Jesus, I take authority over this day. Every hour of this day is sanctified. Every minute of this day is blessed. Every second of this day is covered. I decree that the angels of God are assigned to me. They go before me to prepare the way. They stand beside me to guide my steps. They follow behind me to protect my path. They surround me to shield me from every attack. I am protected. I am preserved. I am kept by the power of God. I decree that as I step out today, I walk in the anointing. The spirit of the Lord is upon me. The power of God flows through me. Signs and wonders follow me. Miracles and breakthroughs accompany me. Everywhere I go, the atmosphere shifts. Darkness flees. Light shines. Captives are set free. The sick are healed. The oppressed are delivered. The bound are loosed. I am a carrier [music] of revival. I am a vessel of transformation. I am an agent of the kingdom. Father, I pray for everyone engaging with this prayer. I decree that their morning is commanded. Their day is blessed. Their season is shifting. Every delay in their life is broken. Every stagnation is ended. Every limitation is [music] removed. I decree acceleration. I decree speed. I decree suddenlies. What they have been waiting for, they will receive it speedily. What they have been believing for, they will see it manifest quickly. Breakthroughs are coming. Miracles are happening. Doors are opening. Opportunities are appearing. Resources are flowing. Connections are being made. I decree over their health, every sickness is leaving. Every disease is departing. Healing virtue is flowing into their bodies. Strength is being restored. Vitality is being renewed. They will live long. They will live strong. They will fulfill their days in health and in strength. I decree over their finances, poverty is broken. Lack is ended. Insufficiency is destroyed. Money is coming to them. Wealth is flowing to them. Resources are being released to them. They will not beg. They will not borrow. They will not lack. They are blessed. They are prosperous. They are abundant. I decree over their families, every curse is broken. Every bondage is loosed. Every stronghold is pulled down. Their spouses are blessed. Their children are blessed. Their homes are blessed. Peace reigns in their households. Love flourishes in their relationships. Unity is established in their families. They will see the salvation of the Lord in their homes. They will see the glory of God in their families. They will see the covenant of God manifested in their generations. Father, I thank you for answered prayers. I thank you for the manifestation of these decrees. I thank you that your word does not return void but accomplishes what you please and prospers in the thing where to you sent it. I seal this prayer with the blood of Jesus. I cover every word with the fire of the Holy Ghost. Let it stand as a testimony. Let it stand as a memorial. Let it stand as a decree that cannot be reversed. A verdict that cannot be overturned. A judgment that cannot be appealed. In the mighty name of Jesus, I have prayed. Amen. Now, I want you to receive this by faith. The Bible says in Mark 11:24, "What [music] things soever you desire, when you pray, believe that you receive them and you shall have them." You have prayed. Now, believe. Believe that it is done. Believe that it is settled. Believe that it is manifested. Don't go into your day with doubt. Don't go into your day with fear. Don't go into your day with uncertainty. Go with confidence. Go with boldness. Go with assurance. You have commanded your morning. You have set the tone. You have established the atmosphere. Now, walk in the reality of what you have decreed. Walk in the power of what you have spoken. Walk in the authority of who you are in Christ. And remember, this is not a one-time thing. This is a lifestyle. Every morning, take time to command your day. Every morning, take time to pray. Every morning, take time to decree the word of God. Make it a habit. Make it a discipline. Make it a priority. And you will see transformation. You will see breakthroughs. You will see the glory of God manifested in your life in ways you have never seen before. The enemy will have no access. Sickness will have no place. Poverty will have no grip. Failure will have no hold. Because you are establishing your day from the realm of the spirit. You are commanding your morning with fire. And that fire will burn away every obstacle, consume every hindrance, and clear the path for your destiny to manifest. Glory to God. I receive the manifestation of this word in your life in Jesus's mighty name. Amen.
